# Honest Penny

> Honest Penny is a free coupon and deals website. Every offer is verified against a page on the retailer's own website; the source domain and verification date are shown on every offer card. Expired offers are removed in freshness sweeps and every removal is logged publicly on the Sources page.

## Key facts
- Website: https://honest-penny.vercel.app
- Verified offers currently listed: 247
- Stores with live offers: 86
- Distinct retailer source domains: 89
- Price: free for shoppers; no account required to view offers.
- How verification works: an offer is listed only when its code or deal terms are visible on the retailer's own promo, sale, offers or member page. The source URL and verification date are stored with the offer.
